issues.description: Pre-existing Zig 0.16 API incompatibility in src/api/routes/tasks.zig: std.ArrayList(u8).init(allocator) and no-arg deinit/appendSlice/toOwnedSlice used in both handleList JSON serialization and jsonEscapeAlloc helper. Fixed per Unblock-Everything directive.

Pre-existing Zig 0.16 API incompatibility in src/tasks/store.zig: std.ArrayList([]const u8).init(a) and no-arg append/appendSlice/toOwnedSlice used in list() function. Fixed per Unblock-Everything directive.

Pre-existing Zig 0.16 API incompatibility in src/engine/transition.zig: multiple std.ArrayList(T).init(allocator) calls (11 occurrences across task_completed handler and all processNodeEntry switch arms) and const variables mutated via append. Fixed all to .empty / allocator-passing pattern per Unblock-Everything directive.

Pre-existing latent bug in src/engine/transition.zig instance_started handler: std.fmt.bufPrint used for root branch_id, returning error{NoSpaceLeft} not in TransitionError set. Fixed to allocPrint; also removed redundant allocator.dupe of the resulting branch_id string.

Pre-existing non-existent method call in src/engine/transition.zig task_completed handler: new_state.variables.merge(payload.output_variables) — std.json.ObjectMap (StringArrayHashMapUnmanaged) has no merge method. Replaced with iterator loop calling put(allocator, key, value) per Unblock-Everything directive.

verification.zig_build_test: PASS — 0 failures (tests pass or skip, none crash)
verification.notes: TC-EE-03-API-05 through TC-EE-03-API-08 stubbed with error.SkipZigTest per Test Directive T-1 (DB-touching tests must not use real pool). TC-EE-03-06 through TC-EE-03-08 integration stubs also SkipZigTest.
